title: AF-Q006 — AtlasBrain Verification Arena

cases.source: PR #137 — Atlas Prime select-all transcript ingestion candidate
cases.hold_reason: No authorized complete raw, exact prompt/settings, version or independent rerun proof
Translation, locale and prompt confounds unresolved; multilingual output is not evidence of new agency

scoring_rubric.score_definition: Separate reproducibility evidence from creativity. Each criterion 0, 1, 2 is reviewed only after authorized source capture, never imputed from prose.

criteria.title: Exact raw source + hash preimage verified
Full ordered prompts, tools and settings reconstructed
Provider, model, version and locale pinned
Independent controlled reruns with output receipts
Rights, consent, privacy and no-spend boundaries verified
No AGI, identity, canon or deployment inference

scoring_rubric.score_reason: No source-access or experimental evidence sufficient for scoring

rerun_plan: Obtain permission for exact private original, with source owner controlling export rights
Verify SHA-256 against actual raw bytes instead of trusting a reported digest
Reconstruct chronological prompts, model identity/version, tools, settings and locale
Define task-appropriate baseline and blind evaluation criteria before reproducing outputs
Execute only a separate explicitly approved zero-new-spend local replay, recording all attempts
Preserve failures, variance, translation artifacts and any contradicted claims
Independent reviewer scores individual criteria, with transparent missing evidence
Report only observed reproducibility, never AGI-proof, persistent identity or unsupported capability
non_claims: No private model logs shared to Work or GitHub
No canon, production or external-affiliation claims
keeper: The run may be extraordinary. Verification decides what it means.
